title: nof1kit 0.1.0
text: First release. design_schedule(): exact uniform sampling balanced, run-constrained randomization schedules dynamic programming, reproducible required seed. check_schedule(): design diagnostics (counts, run lengths, alternations, lag-1 autocorrelation). write_schedule(): JSON export format read companion mobile collection tools. sim_power(): simulation-based power false-positive rates AR(1) errors, analysed without dependence, randomized user-supplied schedules. read_ema(): tidy import EMA exports (CSV JSON), study-day index derived start date error file’s index disagrees calendar. validate_ema(): structured integrity checks, including day indices drifted step calendar. compliance(): prompt-level compliance response windows, -window records reported separately. Vignette running full lifecycle bundled 70-day study.
